verdict.rationale: gstack installs and runs entirely on the user's machine. It supports a git-clone install, global or vendored installs, and a dev mode that reads skills straight from a local checkout. It also ships its own local headless Chromium daemon and keeps learnings in local files under ~/.gstack. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license or self-hosting statement, documentation of running without any vendor-hosted dependency or telemetry, and independent hands-on corroboration of a fully self-hosted setup.
